description_en: Queries a list of data validation templates with paging. Supports filtering by check type, template name, and whether the template is built-in. General node templates can be downloaded without authentication
description_zh: 分页查询数据校验模板列表，支持按校验类型、模板名称、是否内置筛选；通用任务模板下载，无需鉴权
kebab_example: aliyun lhm get-data-check-template-list --check-type 1 --template-name '数据量校验模板' --is-builtin 0 --id-list 3f2a1c9e-8b7d-4e6f-9a01-2b3c4d5e6f70 --tenant-id 10001 --is-admin true --request-id 1EBD0C05-6C1F-4B7A-9C3D-2A8F7E6B5C4D --page-size 20 --page-index 1 --order-by gmtCreate --order-direction DESC --group-by order_date --need-total-count true --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDataCheckTemplateList

parameters.help_en:
The validation rule type. Valid values:
0: data volume comparison.
1: metric comparison.
2: weak content comparison.
3: custom comparison.
4: full-text comparison.
5: null rate comparison
parameters.help_zh: 校验规则类型：0-数据量比对，1-指标比对，2-弱内容对比，3-自定义比对，4-全文比对，5-空值率比对
parameters.name: check_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the validation template
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the template is built-in. Valid values:
0: No. The template is a custom template.
1: Yes. The template is a built-in template
parameters.help_zh: 是否内置模板：0-否（自定义），1-是（内置）
parameters.name: is_builtin

parameters.help_en: The list of validation template UUIDs. The source code of CheckTemplatePagedQry indicates that this parameter has no actual effect and does not need to be exposed externally. It is retained only for backward compatibility with legacy calls. Passing this parameter does not affect query results
parameters.help_zh: 校验模板 UUID 列表。源码 CheckTemplatePagedQry 标注该参数「无实际作用」「无需对外透出」，保留仅为兼容历史调用，传入后不影响查询结果
parameters.name: id_list

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and does not need to be passed. The source code of CheckTemplatePagedQry marks this parameter with @Deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃参数，无需传入。源码 CheckTemplatePagedQry 标注 @Deprecated「参数已废弃」
parameters.name: is_admin

parameters.help_en: The page size, which specifies the number of records returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页返回的记录数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The field used for sorting. Configure this parameter as needed
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，按实际情况配置
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction. Valid values:
ASC: ascending order.
DESC: descending order
parameters.name: order_direction

parameters.help_en: The field used for grouping (GROUP BY condition). Configure this parameter as needed
parameters.help_zh: 分组字段（GROUP BY 条件），按实际情况配置
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return the total record count in the paginated results
parameters.help_zh: 是否需要在分页结果中返回总记录数
parameters.name: need_total_count

data.description_en: The data list returned by the operation. For the structure of each element, see the child field descriptions
data.description_zh: 接口返回的数据列表，元素结构参见下级子字段说明

checkType.description_en:
The validation rule type. Valid values:
0: data volume comparison.
1: metric comparison.
2: weak content comparison.
3: custom comparison.
4: full-text comparison.
5: null rate comparison
checkType.description_zh: 校验规则类型：0-数据量比对，1-指标比对，2-弱内容对比，3-自定义比对，4-全文比对，5-空值率比对

checkTypeExport.description_en: The display name of the check type, used in exported reports
checkTypeExport.description_zh: 校验类型中文名（导出报告字段）

checkTypeName.description_en: The name of the check type

dsTypes.description_en: The list of covered data source types. Multiple values are separated by commas
dsTypes.description_zh: 覆盖的数据源类型列表，多个以英文逗号分隔

engineTypes.description_en: The list of covered validation engine types, such as Tez and MapReduce. When returned as a string, multiple values are separated by commas
engineTypes.description_zh: 覆盖的校验引擎类型列表，例如 Tez、MapReduce；字符串形式时多个值以英文逗号分隔

isBuiltin.description_en:
Specifies whether the template is built-in. Valid values:
0: No. The template is a custom template.
1: Yes. The template is a built-in template
isBuiltin.description_zh: 是否内置模板：0-否（自定义），1-是（内置）

isUsedByTask.description_en:
Indicates whether the template is referenced by a validation task. Valid values:
true: The template is referenced.
false: The template is not referenced.
The delete operation does not verify this reference relationship. Confirm before deleting
isUsedByTask.description_zh: 模板是否已被校验任务使用：true-已被引用，false-未被引用。删除接口不校验该引用关系，建议删除前先确认

templateId.description_en: The validation template ID (logical foreign key) that uniquely identifies a validation template
templateId.description_zh: 校验模板 ID（逻辑外键），唯一标识一个校验模板

templateName.description_en: The name of the validation template

errCode.description_en: The error code. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. An empty string is returned if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed. Check errCode and errMessage for details
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
